beats.text: To recap. Read the graph's baseline, mixing time and cooling region. Closing recall. A cooling line has a slope of negative zero point zero zero two degrees per second. Extrapolating back fifty seconds to the mixing time, how much does the temperature increase?

Fifty seconds times zero point zero zero two degrees per second is zero point one degrees, added to the start of the cooling line. Next episode: comparing fuels fairly, and what sustainability really requires.
